LESSON: VIRTUES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: AKHALAQ
Topic 5.1: Virtues

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Virtues. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should a Muslim work?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
2. explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
3. describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
   In simple words: practise until you can state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings
   In simple words: practise until you can describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Virtues using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Virtues in the examples.
2. Explain Virtues to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Virtues.
4. Show that you can: state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Virtues using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Virtues important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss why work is considered Ibadah in Islam,
2. Collect pictures of different occupations and display them in class,
3. Learning to Learn: relationships are developed as learners search and watch video clips on different types of work and differentiate between permissible and non-permissible.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim work?
2. Why is work considered an act of Ibadah?
3. What kind of work is prohibited in Islam?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
2. explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
3. describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
